a.lede: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.
a.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing

b.lede: Nvidia’s place at the center of the US economy may have outweighed concerns about its CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, national security and foreign policy experts say.
b.title: Jensen Huang’s Return Shows Nvidia Is Too Big to Police
